Remark
[Jacobi fields along a geodesic in a symmetric space]

Source: petersen:page-0405, petersen:page-0406 ↗ def:pet-ch10-tp-decomposition 1. ch10:10.5.3Let $M$ be a symmetric space and $c$ a geodesic. (1) If $E(t)$ is parallel along $c$, show $R(E,\dot c)\dot c$ is parallel. (2) If $E(0)$ is an eigenvector of $R(\cdot ,\dot c(0))\dot c(0)$ with eigenvalue $\kappa $, show $J_1(t)=\operatorname {sn}_\kappa (t)E(t)$ and $J_2(t)=\operatorname {sn}_\kappa '(t)E(t)$ are Jacobi fields along $c$. (3) If $J$ is a Jacobi field with $J(0)=0$, $J'(t_0)=0$, show $J(t_0/u)=0$ for the appropriate rescaling parameter $u$. (4) With $J$ as in (3), construct a geodesic variation $c(s,t)$ with $\partial _sc(0,t)=J(t)$, $c(s,0)=c(0)$, $c(s,t_0)=c(t_0)$.
